text: Program Description 1. Training Goal Editor Notes: The graduates can master the knowledge of Economics, Management, Economic Law, as well as the basic skill and method on Business Management. To be familiar with the rule of operation, trade and the knowledge of business economic benefit analysis. To be engaged in management, teaching and researching in a business unit, government department, or research institute. 2. Program Introduction Editor Notes: This major aims at cultivating the high-level management talents . To cultivate students with good knowledge structure of Management, higher management quality and stronger innovation competence, familiar with policies and regulations of enterprise management. To be fit for the management post in the enterprises, institutions and department of administrative management and suitable for management research. Students can find employment of management system development, integrated management, planning management, quality management, management training, engineering project analysis, etc. This major belongs to the first brand majors of Jiangsu University and the brand major of Jiangsu Province. This major conducts chiefly the teaching and training in terms of the main functions of business enterprise management. It opens only when there are over 10 applicants. ​​ ​ ​ 3. Program Structure Editor Notes: The study of BA program lasts 4 years in all and is composed of four type courses. The Key Courses The key courses which will be instructed in the 4 years include: Principles of Management Operation Management Principles of Economics Human Resource Management Operational Research Organization Behavior Management Information System Business Operation Strategy Business Statistics Economic Law Accounting Business & Ethic Financial Management Management Communication Marketing International Trade You could download Curriculum Schedule for the BA Program here 4. Internship & Future Career Editor Notes: The employment rate of this program is very good. To be familiar with the rule of operation, trade and the knowledge of business economic benefit analysis. To be engaged in management, teaching and researching in a business unit, government department, or research institute. The employment situation of this major is good. The employment rate stays above 98% in the recent three years. Graduates can be in engaged in comprehensive management works or work for the special management business of all kinds of profits or nonprofit organizations. They can work in college, scientific research units to do scientific research or teaching, etc. 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: Jiangsu University is a comprehensive teaching-and-research-type university. Jiangsu University , situated in a beautiful and well-known historic and cultural city on the southern bank of the Yangtze River - Zhenjiang, is a comprehensive teaching-and-research-type university featuring engineering, one of its five chief fields: engineering, medicine, science, management and humanities, Learn More>> 6. School of Management Editor Notes: School of Management in Jiangsu University stems from the cadres training class which was established in November, 1982. Jiangsu University MBA Education Center and Jiangsu University SME Academy are also established relying on this school. The school was honored with "Chinese SME Project Research Training Camps". "SME Development Research Center" was approved to be "Jiangsu SME Development Research Base", which is the first "Social Science Research Base" of Jiangsu Province. The school has 6 research institution. 7. Faculty Editor Notes: The two teachers will be introduced specifically.
